provenance.construction: five-qubit perfect code (stabilizer tableau XZZXI / IXZZX / XIXZZ / ZXIXZ; reproduced from the Error Correction Zoo entry stab_5_1_3, https://errorcorrectionzoo.org/c/stab_5_1_3)
provenance.notes: Reproduced from the Error Correction Zoo entry stab_5_1_3 (https://errorcorrectionzoo.org/c/stab_5_1_3); gate found no exact or WL-equivalent board entry.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.
